summary: Tested the Grand Wonders of Europe group tour from end to end against REAL Razorpay test mode. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases pass. They cover 12 departures with milestones (50% due 45 days before, 100% due 30 days before, never earlier than today+7), single room -> 400, the 2 pax 2027-03-15 quote (total 351352, deposit 10000, due dates 2027-01-29 and 2027-02-13), real order_ id, bad signature -> 400, HMAC verify -> paid plus the first '50% payment' Payment Link (165676, rzp.io), a repeat verify creating no duplicate link, cron 401 with no or wrong bearer, accepted then duplicate, the 'final payment' link (175676, due 2027-02-13) after the first link was marked paid, and mock bookings never getting links. Frontend: title, chips (users icon), breadcrumb, route (10 places), Planned by Sharon, expert popup (opened, not submitted), 16 itinerary days with correct meals and overnights, 10 route pins with the active pin following the scroll, 12 departure rows at ₹1,75,676, month tabs, booking modal (twin-only text, ₹5,000 x pax, 'rest due 1 Dec' for 15 Dec and 'due 13 Feb' for 15 Mar), the real Razorpay checkout iframe in Test Mode showing ₹10,000 for 2 pax, and the thank-you page with the gthanks-balance-link card (₹1,65,676, due 29 Jan 2027, Pay now opens rzp.io in a new tab). Regression: Sri Lanka chips and its 12 departures, and the Bangkok plane chip and its 7 Dec ₹63,000 departure, are unchanged. Found 2 visual bugs: the Day 1 image is a 404 and the London map label is cut off. Two older regression tests are now out of date.

minor.issue: Only links with status created or partially_paid block a new link. If a link expires, the hourly job makes a new one for the same milestone. After the due date expire_by is now+1 day, so the customer gets a new SMS and email every day. If ops cancel a link in the Razorpay dashboard, it is recreated within an hour. Decide the policy, for example cap re-sends per milestone or skip milestones with a cancelled link.

For 15 Dec 2026 both milestones clamp to 2026-12-01. The customer gets a '50% payment' link and, after paying it, a second 'final payment' link due the same day. Merge milestones that share a due date into one 100% link.
Nothing stops two links being created for the same milestone at the same time: there is no lock or unique index on booking+milestone. If verify and the hourly cron run together, both can push a link.

The razorpay client calls (order.create, payment_link.create, payment_link.fetch) block, but they run directly inside async handlers and background tasks, so they hold up the event loop. Wrap them in run_in_threadpool / asyncio.to_thread.
The top-level 'balance_due_days' is still 60 (the global BALANCE_DUE_DAYS), which contradicts the Europe 45/30-day terms. The frontend may not use it, but the API is inconsistent.

RAZORPAY_KEY_ID and RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET are NOT in /app/backend/.env as the brief says. They come only from the backend process environment. Make sure deployment provides them, otherwise the app silently falls back to MOCK.

ui_bugs.issue: IMG.londonNight = pexels photo 42061 returns 404, so Day 1 shows a broken image with its alt text.

The 'London' label sits about 11px outside the left edge of the map box and shows as 'don'. Cause: 'london' is in labelLeft in grandWondersEuropeData.map while its pin is at the far left. Remove london from labelLeft or move origin/viewBox.

critical_code_review_comments: balance_links.py: OPEN=('created','partially_paid') means expired and cancelled links trigger a re-send. Under the current policy this causes repeated SMS and email.

balance_links.sync_booking: if marking a booking fully_paid works but a link fetch failed earlier, the error is logged and the booking retried next hour, which is OK. But one link paid partially (accept_partial False, so unlikely) is not handled.
bookings.verify: send_next_link gets the pre-update doc. This is fine today but fragile if send_next_link starts checking status.
group_bookings.departures: 'idx = len(out)' is computed before the lead-day filter, so seat patterns shift as dates roll off. That is acceptable for sample data.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Test bookings (qa+eu*@example.com, TEST_EU names) were deleted by booking_id, all Razorpay payment links created were cancelled (verified status=cancelled), and the TEST_ cron_runs were removed. 3 bookings left by the legacy test_group_deposit_v2 run (TEST_v2*) were deleted by id. Enquiry forms were not submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Razorpay keys are in the uvicorn process env (/proc/<pid>/environ), not backend/.env. test_europe_balance_links.py reads them from there. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_europe_balance_links.py -n0. It cleans up bookings, links and cron_runs itself. Server date is 2026-11-24. The Razorpay checkout opens in Test Mode. Dummy phone prefill is not accepted (expected).
